title: Custom Audiences
objectives: Define what a Custom Audience is and how it differs from cold targeting
Identify the 3 major data sources: Website, Customer List, and Social Engagement
Apply recency windows to segment warm leads

blocks.text: Welcome to Operator tier! Now we stop guessing and start marketing to people who already know your brand.
A Custom Audience connects people who already interacted with your business directly to Meta's ad engine.

blocks.title: The Regular Customer Analogy
blocks.text: If a regular customer walks into a sweet shop, you don't introduce yourself again. You offer them their favorite laddoos with a discount. That is a Custom Audience!

blocks.title: The 3 Major Custom Audience Sources
items: 1. Website Visitors (tracked by Meta Pixel, e.g. past 14-day cart abandoners)
2. Customer Lists (CSV upload of phone numbers and emails of past buyers)
3. Meta Sources (people who watched 50% of your Instagram Reel or messaged your page)

blocks.text: Always segment by recency: a person who visited your site yesterday is 5x more likely to buy than someone who visited 90 days ago.
Ensure your customer list matches Indian phone formats with country code (+91) to maximize match rates.

quiz.q: Which of the following is an example of a Meta Custom Audience?
options: People living in Mumbai interested in cricket
People who visited your website pricing page in the last 14 days
quiz.hint: Think of people who have already touched your business assets.
quiz.explain: Custom Audiences are built from first-party data: website traffic, customer lists, or app engagement.

quiz.q: Why is a 7-day website visitor audience generally more profitable than a 180-day visitor audience?
options: Recency: The purchase intent is fresh in the customer's mind
quiz.explain: Recent visitors have high brand recall and immediate intent, resulting in higher conversion rates.

quiz.q: True or False: You can create a Custom Audience of people who watched at least 50% of your Instagram video Reel.
quiz.hint: Meta tracks video watch time internally without needing a website pixel.
quiz.explain: True! Video engagement audiences are free and do not rely on browser cookies.

quiz.q: What phone number format should you use when uploading customer lists in India for maximum match rate?
options: PIN code instead of phone number
quiz.explain: Including +91 helps Meta accurately match phone numbers to user profiles.

recap: Custom Audiences target warm users based on website visits, customer lists, or video views.
Prioritize recency (e.g. 7-14 days) to capture high-intent buyers.
